descriptions.w3d_d40d_worm_graphic_update_80133d74: Per-frame update of a worm's graphic: shows or hides the mesh by camera distance and state, copies position and rotation from the simulation entry, fires a due notification, updates turn blending, places the mesh, fades three shadow parts along a downward test ray, offsets the mesh when rotation differs from the entry, and posts a splash message after moving in shallow water.
